text:
Ari: Heads-up — ran the HF->Redwood converter against openai-ish/chat-clone v2 and hit a weird token-shift + partial safetensors download issue. Posting logs and repro steps.
Samir: ugh, details? looks similar to the shard-mismatch things but token-shift sounds new.
Ari: Repro command I used:
```
export HF_TOKEN=***
redwood-convert hf://org/chat-clone --revision v2 --out model.redwood --auth $HF_TOKEN
```
Error output (truncated):
```
INFO: downloading index.safetensors
WARNING: shard 00002.safetensors missing, attempting retry
ERROR: partial download detected: index refers to 3 shards but only 2 found
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "convert.py", line 312, in main
    model = load_safetensors_index(index_path)
  File "convert.py", line 58, in load_safetensors_index
    raise RuntimeError("safetensors index mismatch")
RuntimeError: safetensors index mismatch
```
Ari: After manually re-downloading all shards the convert finished but tokenizer mapping was off in the resulting Redwood model — chat templates showed system prompt token fused with user token (off-by-one). Example:
```
input_ids: [1, 50256, 345, ...]
decoded: "</s>Hi there"
```
Samir: That decoded "</s>Hi" indicates the special token id mapping changed. Did the converter honor tokenizer.json's "special_tokens_map" vs the HF tokenizer's added_tokens?
Ari: I inspected tokenizer.json from HF; it had both added_tokens and special_tokens_map. The converter's log shows it read tokenizer.vocab_size and forced eos_token_id=0 which isn't what HF tokenizer has.
Jenna: Do you have a minimal repro script? I can add it to CI.
Ari: Yes — quick repro script attached here (pasted):
```
# repro_token_shift.py
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
t = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('org/chat-clone', revision='v2')
print('eos', t.eos_token, t.eos_token_id)
print('bos', t.bos_token, t.bos_token_id)
print('special_map', t.special_tokens_map)
```
Running that against the local HF checkout shows eos_token_id=2 but after conversion the Redwood tokenizer has eos_token_id=0.
Samir: Hmm — I remember we had a key-rename patch for weights where we renamed 'model.decoder' -> 'gpt_neox' for some LoRA compat earlier. Could the converter be accidentally remapping tokenizer ids from a weight-key transformation path? Sounds unlikely but possible overlap in code paths.
Jenna: Also saw the partial shard download in logs — ops-bot reported a transient 401 from HF hub during that run which produced a truncated index file. Could be two separate issues: (1) hub auth/retry not robust -> corrupted safetensors index; (2) tokenizer special_tokens parsing bug when both added_tokens and special_tokens_map present.
ops-bot: deploy-bot shows latest conversion job #1423 failed with exit code 1 on 1768504321-runner01. HF hub returned 401 for shard 00002 for ~7s; retry policy then gave up after 3 attempts.
Samir: For the tokenizer bug, probable root cause: converter was falling back to reading config.json['vocab_size'] and then building a new TokenizerFast without preserving special token ids. I'll try to reproduce locally with a patched converter that preserves tokenizer.save_pretrained() output directly.
Ari: Minimal mitigation: don't run conversion on that model from CI until we patch, and if you must use it, manually rsync all shards and run the HF tokenizer roundtrip to confirm ids.
Jenna: I'll open a PR with two fixes:
- increase hub retry timeout + verify shard checksums before writing index
- preserve tokenizer special token ids by loading tokenizer from huggingface and copying special_tokens_map/unfied added_tokens into the Redwood tokenizer serialization routine
Samir: assign to me for quickfix for the tokenizer code path. I'll add unit test: load a HF tokenizer with conflicting added_tokens/special_tokens_map and assert converted.eos_token_id == original.eos_token_id.
Ari: Adding note — we saw the issue only on revision v2 (works on v1). There was a modelcard change that added an extra placeholder token in added_tokens between v1 and v2. That change probably exposed the bug.
Jenna: TY. I'll also add an integration test that simulates partial shard download and ensures convert fails early with a clear message and retries more.
Ari: Thanks. Putting a hold on onboarding this model for now. @Samir please post a short PR link here when ready so QA can validate.
Samir: will do, targeting a patch today. :thumbsup:
Jenna: Filing a follow-up support ticket for customer who was testing v2; cc'ing support later.
Ari: Thanks all.
